records.title: Jordan CPI, January–June 2026
records.abstract: A source-linked descriptive note showing that Jordan's official annual headline CPI rate rose from 1.06% in January to 2.83% in May 2026 before easing to 2.79% in June, while month-on-month inflation cooled to 0.14% by June.
records.suggested_citation: MENA Open Data & Evidence Lab (2026). Jordan CPI, January–June 2026: Evidence Brief. Version 1.0.

records.title: When does the same unemployment rate stop meaning the same thing? Jordan, Egypt and Morocco
records.abstract: A source-linked comparison of labour-force measurement perimeters showing that Jordan, Egypt and Morocco all center unemployment measurement on a 15+ framework while differing materially in population scope and classification architecture.
records.suggested_citation: MENA Open Data & Evidence Lab (2026). When does the same unemployment rate stop meaning the same thing? Jordan, Egypt and Morocco. Data Note, version 1.0.
